requirement:
The harness MUST record the sources it supplies to the model, including
mandatory inputs and additional reads, using the evidence input formats
defined by {cite}`requirements.ci.outline_inputs`,
{cite}`requirements.ci.requirements_inputs`, and
{cite}`requirements.definitions.inputs`. The harness MUST create these records
itself so ordinary evidence validation can check them later.
rationale:
## Obligations and coverage

1. **Record mandatory sources supplied to the model.** `src/authoring/mod.rs#fn[converse]` initializes `pending` from `mandatory_inputs()` and records those inputs after a successful provider response. `src/authoring/inputs.rs#impl[AssessmentSources]/fn[record_inputs]` maintains the harness-owned record, deduplicating repeated inputs. `tests/authoring_cli.rs#fn[stdout_emits_only_evidence_json_without_changing_project_files]` asserts that the resulting evidence contains mandatory requirement, definition, and outline inputs.

2. **Record additional source reads supplied to the model.** `src/authoring/tools.rs#fn[read]` constructs deliveries containing the selected source and accompanying definitions. `src/authoring/pages.rs#impl[ResultPages]/fn[deliver]` and `src/authoring/pages.rs#fn[delivered]` associate only the delivered entries and their definitions with each page. `converse` accumulates these deliveries and records them when sent. Coverage includes `src/authoring/mod.rs#mod[tests]/fn[only_inputs_on_delivered_pages_are_recorded]`, `src/authoring/pages.rs#mod[tests]/fn[paged_inputs_carry_their_definitions_and_deliver_only_their_own_inputs]`, and `src/authoring/tools.rs#mod[tests]/fn[reading_records_only_delivered_sources_and_their_terms]`. The CLI tests `tests/authoring_cli.rs#fn[ollama_cli_delivers_sources_records_fixme_and_keeps_usage_content_free]` and `tests/authoring_cli.rs#fn[bedrock_cli_uses_selected_profile_region_and_converse_tools]` also assert persisted additional reads.

3. **Use the cited outline evidence format.** The reachable `src/inputs.rs#impl[InputSelector]/fn[resolve]` resolves outline nodes and obtains their structural hashes; `src/inputs.rs#impl[InputSelector]/fn[to_input]` constructs their evidence form. `src/inputs.rs#fn[recorded_input]` removes model-facing source text and kind, retaining `file`, `item`, and `hash`. Exact recorded outline values are asserted by `src/authoring/tools.rs#mod[tests]/fn[reading_records_only_delivered_sources_and_their_terms]` and `src/authoring/tools.rs#mod[tests]/fn[line_range_reads_record_the_innermost_covering_nodes]`; the stdout CLI test also asserts the exact field set.

4. **Use the cited requirements evidence format.** `src/authoring/inputs.rs#fn[source_input]` reaches `InputSelector::resolve` and `to_model_input`. These construct the selection, sorted matches, and declaration snapshot through `src/inputs.rs#impl[InputSelector]/fn[to_input]`; recording preserves this form. The stdout CLI test asserts the mandatory selection is recorded, and the Ollama CLI test passes the generated evidence through ordinary repository validation.

5. **Use the cited definition evidence format.** The same selector path constructs `definition` and declaration `text`, which recording preserves. The source-tool test checks delivered definition text includes its phrase option; the paged-input test verifies accompanying definitions are delivered with their own pages. Both CLI tests above verify recorded mandatory definitions, and the Ollama test checks ordinary evidence validation accepts the generated record.

6. **Create the records in the harness itself so ordinary validation can check them later.** `converse`, `record_inputs`, and `recorded_input` construct and maintain the inputs independently of the model submission. The CLI tests submit only a determination and rationale yet obtain complete evidence inputs. The Ollama CLI test explicitly runs `validate_repository` and asserts no validation error for that evidence.

The cited requirements' validation machinery is context, not a separate subject of reassessment. The inspected paths and subject-marked tests cover the subject's recording and format-application obligations; no gap was found.

text: :::{req} delivered_inputs
The harness MUST record the sources it supplies to the model, including
mandatory inputs and additional reads, using the evidence input formats
defined by {cite}`requirements.ci.outline_inputs`,
{cite}`requirements.ci.requirements_inputs`, and
{cite}`requirements.definitions.inputs`. The harness MUST create these records
itself so ordinary evidence validation can check them later.
:::{req} outline_inputs
For an outline input, Habeas MUST parse `file` with its language's grammar under
{cite}`requirements.references.outlines` and resolve `item` to exactly one
outline node under {cite}`requirements.references.outline_selectors`. It MUST
compare `hash` with the node's current structural hash under
{cite}`requirements.references.structural_hash`. It MUST derive the node's
inclusive line range, including attached comments and attributes, during
validation for display and reference coverage. Moving the node, editing other
nodes, or editing comments its profile does not hash MUST NOT invalidate the
input. Habeas MUST report a missing file, unsupported language, parse failure,
invalid or ambiguous selector, or changed hash.
:::{req} requirements_inputs

For a requirements input, `requirements` MUST be a {term}`requirements.references.definition_selection`, and Habeas MUST match it against all defined requirements and named examples. It MUST recompute the matches during validation, sort their full names, and compare them with `matches`. It MUST take each match's complete raw fenced declaration, including its opening and closing lines, concatenate those declarations in full-name order with one blank line between them, and compare the resulting raw lines with `text`. It MUST retain every match's current source file and inclusive line range for display and reference coverage. A selection matching no definitions MUST be invalid. Adding, removing, renaming, or changing a matched definition MUST invalidate the stored input; moving an unchanged declaration within the book MUST NOT. Errors MUST identify the selection and affected definitions when available.
:::{req} inputs

Evidence inputs MAY have a definition form containing exactly `definition` and `text`. `definition` MUST identify one named definition; `text` MUST contain its complete raw fenced declaration as source lines, including its phrase option and explanatory body.

Validation MUST reject missing definitions and changed snapshot text, identifying the definition and showing a compact diff when available. Moving an unchanged definition within its chapter MUST NOT invalidate its snapshot. Evidence displays MUST show the definition name, current source location, and recorded text.
:::{definition} definition_selection
:phrase: definition selection
A full requirement or example name, or a definition glob, identifying the
requirements and named examples it matches under
{cite}`requirements.references.definition_globs`. A name without `*` selects
exactly that definition.
